note: Guthrie County Conservation park on the Middle Raccoon River in Panora, at the old Lenon Mill dam; the first access on the Middle Raccoon River Water Trail. 16 electric RV sites plus primitive camping: RV pads line the gravel entrance road south of the bridge, with a few more sites on the grass by the river below the dam. Restrooms open in spring as weather permits and close for fall and winter. Small enough that big rigs should call ahead. --Claude
summary: Fees $20 per unit and FCFS (envelope registration) confirmed; potable water confirmed. Pages give no site count, amperage or season (the county's own site refused). Riverfront kept for the sites below the dam. Pin fine. Note trimmed (price and FCFS dropped as redundant).
flags: WATERFRONT: riverfront kept, but it applies only to the few sites in the lower area. The Middle Raccoon is ~35-45 m wide below the dam (Esri imagery, gravel bars included), so it is a river, not a creek. The pads along the gravel entrance road are ~55-65 m from the river with that road and a tree belt between; a camper on the lower lawn sits ~20-25 m from the water past a narrow tree strip, with no road between. How many sites are in that lower area can't be counted (canopy). Same shape as the Oakland Mills Water Works call.
SITE COUNT: the stored note's '16 electric RV sites' has no source; no Guthrie County page reachable here gives a count. Left in the note (not contradicted), sites group left unset.
WEBSITE: guthriecounty.gov/conservation answered 403 to plain HTTP; the mycountyparks page is the only operator page read. Phone 641-755-3061 matches the GCCB number on it.
PIN: stored 41.68590,-94.37010 is in the trees just east of the lower camping lawn, ~55 m from the camp area's centre (~41.6863,-94.3705). Fine.
